description:
The site's pages and their schedule. A page's status is how far its writing is: planned (not written), writing, ready (written), published, failed, retired. Apart from it, a page has a day (on the schedule, scheduledDate) or none (Unscheduled), and sightkickWrites says whether Sightkick writes it (or wrote it): off, it's yours or the owner's to write before its day, or it goes back to Unscheduled as missed.
view:
- list(status?, limit?, offset?): Pages by Opportunity, with the question each answers, its URL, Google's index verdict, the duplicate check, the plan's verdict and handsOffUntil. Every status but idea (a keyword's page nobody planned) unless asked. Up to 200, page with offset.
- page(articleId, includeContent?): One page: head, status and score, publications, keywords, brief, plan, and once live its URL, index verdict and Search Console. includeContent adds the body and its bodyHash, which a live page's edit needs.
- check_topic(title, primaryKeyword, question?, articleType?): Does the site already answer this? The page it repeats (improve that one instead) or null. 50 per day.
- revisions(articleId): Every agent edit to a live page, newest first. The newest can be undone (publish_page undo_edit) while nobody changed the page since.
- receipt(articleId): What a published page did on Google and in AI answers since it went live.
- shipped(limit?): Pages registered as shipped elsewhere (update_page register), with pageId.
- calendar: Every page on the schedule from today on, by day. fixedDay: put on that day by hand; else it took the next open slot.
- schedule: The publishing schedule: Pages per month (its slots, spread evenly over each month), the hour pages go out, Sightkick's pages (scheduled or unscheduled), the next 30 days slot by slot, Unscheduled (pages without a day) and pages waiting for a slot.
- images(articleId): A page's images in publish order, featured first.
